note.note:
I’m ready to generate the SOAP note, but I need the actual content.

Please provide:
- The transcript (doctor–patient dialogue)
- The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) in JSON format

If possible, also include any explicitly documented:
- Allergies
- Current medications (and dosages if provided)
- Past medical history
- Any reported vitals or physical exam findings
- Any tests or investigations already performed

What I will deliver:
- A structured SOAP note with headings: Subjective, Objective, Assessment & Plan
- Each issue will be named and analyzed per the DDx only if consistent with the transcript; if conflicts exist, I will include both and mark “conflict noted.”
- No facts or numbers will be inferred beyond what is in the transcript or DDx
- American English, concise, professional tone
- A final Quality Checks section noting any missing elements, conflicts, or transcript quality issues

Please paste the transcript and the DDx JSON.
